title: pinus laricio subsp. leptophylla
intro: Pinus laricio subsp. leptophylla, commonly known as Corsican pine, is a subspecies of tree native to the island of Corsica, France. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pinus laricio subsp. leptophylla include soothing coughs, reducing fever, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
